findings.evidence: template/scripts/pr_review_gate.py:214-219 delegates requirement-composition jobs before constructing the llm_env launcher at lines 228-237. template/scripts/requirement_composition.py:136-141 instead launches with credential_free_env, which strips CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN and never reads the declared token_file. This contradicts the delta scenarios requiring the declared token to reach the reviewer and successful login probes to proceed unchanged.
findings.summary: Requirement composition reviews omit the declared login token after passing the pre-claim login probe, so they still fail authentication and consume review attempts.

findings.evidence: template/scripts/lifecycle_workers.py:399 copies os.environ into harness_push_env. Lines 404-405 return it unchanged for local origins; lines 411-418 filter only GIT_CONFIG_* for GitHub origins. push_validated passes this environment to Git at lines 424-425. Adding the token to CREDENTIAL_VARS does not affect this path. The active delta states that no push environment shall contain the token, and proposal.md requires no token in GitHub-facing environments.
findings.summary: The harness push environment still contains an ambient CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN, violating the explicit provider-only credential boundary.
